tools.name: pricing_info
tools.description: Free — list every paid tool in the 'apify-market-intelligence' bundle with its price, payTo address and network. Call this first if you don't have a wallet ready yet.

tools.name: apify-actor-idea-validator
tools.description: Assess one proposed Apify Actor idea against public Store similarity, activity, quality, competition and visible pricing evidence. Public Store API only, no LLM. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: apify-market-gap-finder
tools.description: Compare user-declared niches against the public Apify Store and rank evidence-backed market gaps. Public Store API only, no LLM. — $0.10/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: apify-niche-demand-radar
tools.description: Produce a current demand-direction snapshot for one declared niche using observed public Apify Store user metrics. Public Store API only, no LLM. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: apify-portfolio-expansion-planner
tools.description: Rank user-supplied candidate niches by public Store opportunity and textual adjacency to a user-supplied portfolio. Public Store API only for candidates, no portfolio fetching. — $0.15/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: apify-pricing-benchmark-advisor
tools.description: Summarize visible public Apify Store event-price distributions for a declared cohort. Public Store API only, no LLM. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).
